title: Ajanta Pharma Annual Report FY 2025-26: Revenue Crosses ₹5,000 Crore, PAT Surpasses ₹1,000 Crore Ajanta Pharma delivered a landmark FY 2025-26 with consolidated revenue rising 17% to ₹5,453 crore and PAT growing 15% to ₹1,056 crore, crossing the ₹1,000 crore net profit milestone. US Generics surged 49%, India business grew 14%, and Africa Branded Generics expanded 15%, reflecting broad-based diversified growth. Adjusted EBITDA grew 18% to ₹1,498 crore with a 27% margin, while R&D spend stood at ₹260.37 crore or 4.77% of consolidated turnover. The 47th AGM is scheduled for July 16, 2026, with an interim dividend of ₹28 per share declared for FY 2025-26
